plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked two-photon tracer and beta-amyloid clearance chart from Xie, Kang, Xu, Iliff & Nedergaard (18 October 2013, Science 342: 373–377) shows interstitial fluid space rising >60% (from 14% awake to 23% in slow-wave sleep), CSF tracer influx increasing ~10–20×, and radiolabelled 125I-beta-amyloid clearance rate doubling during sleep vs wakefulness.

teach_overlay.scale: your brain cannot think at full speed and power-wash its own hallways at the same time — so every night it shrinks its support cells by sixty percent and turns on a high-pressure dishwasher while you sleep
